text:
Bitcoin remains mired in a summer doldrum, consolidating tightly around $64,300 as trading volumes compress. Market participants have adopted a decidedly defensive posture, sidelined by an acute lack of immediate catalysts following the delay of the highly anticipated Senate vote on the Crypto CLARITY Act until after the summer recess.

Directional conviction has been further dampened by a sudden halt in institutional momentum, with U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recently snapping a three-week buying streak to record net outflows. Concurrently, a reported $90 million firmware exploit affecting select hardware wallets has introduced localized friction into the self-custody ecosystem.

The digital asset sector is currently held hostage by traditional macroeconomic ambiguity. With manufacturing and services data reviving stagflation concerns, all eyes turn to today's Non-Farm Payrolls report. Investors are searching for clarity on the Federal Reserve's trajectory, particularly as some institutional desks shift expectations toward a potential December rate hike.
